appLead: Browser-only matching. Files stay in this tab — nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored.
privacyNote: All matching runs locally in this tab. Files never leave your device.
docsLead: Short guide for browser-only bank statement matching.
docsStep1: Choose a bank layout (Auto / Generic / Promsvyazbank / Alexs), then upload a statement (PDF / CSV / TXT / ODS).
docsStep2: Upload the income report and the expense report.
docsStep3: Press Match. Comparison runs only in this tab.
docsStep4: Review unmatched rows and download the CSV if needed. Press Clear to reset.
docsMatchBody: Rows match on amount (±0.05), date (±1 day), and purpose text overlap. Near misses and rows present on only one side stay in the unmatched lists.
docsSamplesBody: Ready-made fixtures live in the repository. Download them, then upload in the app.
docsSamplesHint: — synthetic demo for the Generic adapter
docsPromptBody: Clone this starter, put fixtures under public/examples/<bank-id>/, then paste the prompt below into Cursor (or any coding agent). Keep match.ts and the UI bank-agnostic.
docsPromptTip1: Use folder public/examples/<bank-id>/ with bank + income + expense files.
docsPromptTip2: Ask the agent to dump a few PDF text lines first, then fix amount vs balance.
docsPromptTip3: Require bun test && bun run build; do not break generic or public/samples.
docsPrompt:
Read AGENTS.md and .project/plan/bank-adapters.md.
Add bank adapter <id> under src/lib/reconcile/adapters/.
Do not break adapters/generic.ts or public/samples golden tests.
Put fixtures in public/examples/<id>/ with README expected counts.
Wire registry detect + UI label. Stay browser-only; output only LedgerRow[].
Run bun test && bun run build.
